name: stepper-with-titles
description: A horizontal progress stepper with numbered markers, titles, and supporting descriptions.
purpose: Shows where a person is in a short linear flow and lets them jump to a completed or upcoming step.
avoidFor: non-linear tasks that need a sidebar or tabs
dense wizards with more than a handful of steps
